# Lifecycle reference

The tables show state transitions in the [mk2 policy IR](../src/vouch_mk2/ir/mk2.py).
Gates appear in policy IR order. An em dash marks an empty list.
Use the [command reference](commands.md) for arguments and
[concepts](concepts.md) for the workflow.
